pages.title: Sicilian Dwarf Elephant
pages.text: The Sicilian dwarf elephant ($(o)Palaeoloxodon falconeri$()) is an extinct elephant that lived on the islands of Sicily and Malta during the Middle Pleistocene.$(br2)It descended from the straight-tusked elephant, which reached the islands from mainland Europe.$(br2)It was one of the smallest elephants ever known. Adults stood only about one metre tall at the shoulder, a fraction of the size of their mainland ancestors.
